coverage: Bounded verified selection, not an exhaustive gazetteer. 133 communities in 23 municipal groups. Unlisted municipalities and villages are not evidence of unavailable service.
boundaryNotes: Russell source explicitly says only parts of Limoges and Marionville lie in the township. Do not imply exclusive membership; those villages span municipal boundaries.
Carrying Place spans Prince Edward County and Quinte West. Use a qualified location relationship if modelling only one parent.
Young’s Point spans Selwyn and Douro-Dummer. Selwyn municipal plan supports its Selwyn portion.
Dacre is supported by Greater Madawaska municipal tourism postal-area wording. Confirm address for boundary-specific claims.
Rideau Ferry omitted because it spans municipal boundaries; Westport omitted from Rideau Lakes because it is a separate municipality.
Burritts Rapids omitted from North Grenville record because it spans the Ottawa boundary.
Amherst Island is mentioned only in a conditional Loyalist planning note, not treated as a village. Millhaven is supported as the ferry departure location.
Madoc village belongs to Centre Hastings; do not incorrectly assign it to Madoc township.
sourceNotes: North Glengarry page misspells Glen Robertson as Glen Roberston. Dataset uses established spelling Glen Robertson.
South Stormont municipal source abbreviates St Andrews; dataset uses St. Andrews West to distinguish other Ontario places.
Clarence-Rockland sources use St-Pascal Baylon; dataset uses Saint-Pascal-Baylon. Treat as an alias, not a second town.
Dysart et al is the common municipal name. The full legal name is the United Townships of Dysart, Dudley, Harcourt, Guilford, Harburn, Bruton, Havelock, Eyre and Clyde.
Official planning/map sources establish place names and membership only. Conditional tile planning notes are original project scoping guidance, not claims about every building or completed work.
Some municipal sources are historical approved plans or municipal PDFs; no claim is made that this is a complete current settlement list.
No geographic source establishes search volume, ranking, business branch presence, licence coverage or guaranteed job availability.
knownGaps: Not comprehensive for Renfrew, Lanark, Leeds-Grenville, Frontenac, Hastings, Peterborough or Northumberland municipal subdivisions.
No First Nations reserve/community mapping was attempted; authoritative First Nation sources and access/service confirmation would be needed.
Formal municipality records elsewhere may already cover a same-name village (e.g. Russell). Deduplicate slugs by both name and parent geography.
Duplicate names across Ontario require disambiguation, especially Richmond, Wellington, Harmony, Mountain, Elgin, Lancaster, Cardiff and Eagle Lake.
